usedFor: flowyteam holds objectives and key results, and Freshsales Classic revises a deal with “Update Deal” after “New Off-Track Key Result”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Off-Track Key Result” in flowyteam, then “Update Deal” in Freshsales Classic
bestTemplate.why: An off-track result is a warning worth passing on, so the linked deal can change stage or amount.

watchOut: Matching is by deal ID or name in “Update Deal”, so each key result needs a deal reference.
